## Primaquine regimens by G6PD status

| G6PD status | Policy on PQ | Additional safety |
|---|---|---|
| **G6PD deficient** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg/week weekly for 8 weeks | With close medical supervision |
| **G6PD normal** | Adults: PQ 15 mg/day over 14 days Children: PQ 0.25 mg/kg/day over 14 days | Not specified |
| **If no testing available** | Adults: PQ 15 mg/day over 14 days Children: PQ 0.25 mg/kg /day over 14 days | Not specified |
